g.text: M7: native late-checkpoint work; means and snapshot ranges
Limited inlet band with SVV; scope-qualified descriptive comparison. No full-band fidelity or 2% accuracy verdict.
Shading is snapshot min/max, not a confidence interval. Work uses full instantaneous fields; transport, pressure and time-integration terms remain open.
